messages:
sophia (support): FYI customer reports p95/p99 spike for requests that use function-calling + structured output. Started ~09:02 UTC. Alert: tool-router latency > 3s at p99. Logs attached.

ops-bot: Alert: rule=tool-router-p99 latency threshold breached (3s). Count=78 in last 5m.

sophia (support): Repro steps from customer: POST /v1/generate with body including tools array and `output_schema`. Happens reliably for some prompts (attached).

derek (eng-runtime): Can you paste a minimal request that repros? Also need sample model + token counts.

sophia (support): Minimal payload:
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-001-opt",
  "input": "Summarize transaction and call `bank_transfer` tool if amount > 1000",
  "tools": ["bank_transfer"],
  "output_schema": {"type":"object","properties":{"action":{"type":"string"},"amount":{"type":"number"}}}
}
```

sophia (support): Customer: 90% of requests fast (<200ms) but p99 jumps to 4-6s when the validator path is exercised.

maria (eng-ml): That smells like schema validation on the hot path. Validator we rolled in last week does deeper JSONPath + regex checks. Might be O(n^2) on some nested outputs.

tom (eng-sre): I see the same in traces: most time spent in `schema_validator::validate()` on a small subset of requests. Stack shows `validate -> compile_regex -> execute_jsonpath`.

derek (eng-runtime): Two immediate mitigations: 1) route requests with `output_schema` through the slower validator pool (lower concurrency) to avoid head-of-line for other requests, or 2) bypass validator for now for customer specific org. Which is faster to implement?

maria (eng-ml): Bypass is simplest: feature-flag `validator.strict=false` per-org. That will short-circuit heavy checks. I can prepare a patch.

tom (eng-sre): I can add a temporary routing rule to send flagged orgs to `validator-backoff` instance group (lower CPU but isolated). Will take ~20min.

sophia (support): Customer wants a quick mitigation — they prefer bypass for their org for now. Can we do that and keep routing change as fallback?

derek (eng-runtime): OK. Maria send the patch, I'll code the per-org flag hook and a quick config rollout. Tom please also add the routing rule as a safety net.

maria (eng-ml): Pushed PR: `feature/validator-ff` — short-circuits regex/jsonpath checks when `validator.strict=false`. Unit tests included.

derek (eng-runtime): Rolling out ff to staging, then prod for org `acme-corp` only. Deploy plan: canary -> 10% -> 100% for that org. Will monitor p99.

ops-bot: Deploy started: deploy/validator-bypass v1.2 to prod-canary at 09:28 UTC.

tom (eng-sre): Routing rule added as `tool-router:isolate-validator-hotpath` to send flagged orgs to `validator-backoff` if bypass fails.

ops-bot: Deploy success: canary green.

derek (eng-runtime): Post-deploy quick metrics: p99 for `acme-corp` toolcall latency dropped from 5.2s -> 220ms in 10m window. Overall cluster p99 improved by 12%.

sophia (support): Customer confirms latency back to expected range. They accepted bypass as temporary.

maria (eng-ml): Root cause notes: new regex/jsonpath compiler has pathological behavior on some nested schemas producing long backtracking. Next steps: replace with linear-time parser or add compile-time complexity guard.

derek (eng-runtime): Action items: (1) Maria to draft redesign timeline for validator (ETA 2 weeks), (2) Tom to keep routing rule for 48h then remove if stable, (3) Support to draft customer-facing postmortem and remediation steps.

sophia (support): I'll own the customer postmortem and follow-up with a TTR note. Thanks everyone. :+1:
